# WIST branding assets

Unmodified artwork downloaded from the official Westminster International School Tashkent website on 30 October 2026 for the requested local MIS branding.

- `wist-logo.svg`: https://wistedu.com/wp-content/themes/wist-new/assets/img/logo-light.svg
- `wist-icon.png`: https://wistedu.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/cropped-favicons-192x192.png

The full artwork is used on dark backgrounds. The original compact icon is used in narrow navigation, the browser favicon and printable report headers. Original proportions and colours are preserved.

The white-background report wordmark in wist-report-logo.png was extracted from the user-provided report.pdf (logo image only). No pupil photograph or signature was included in the application assets.
